raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "give"
  role subject "the family doctor"
  role object "Prestarium of 5 mg"
  role recipient "the user"
  role time "three weeks ago"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "have a dry cough"
  role subject "the user"
  role time "for a week"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "be able to sleep at night"
  role subject "the user"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "have a cold"
  role subject "the user"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@s5 stated
  relation "have fever"
  role subject "the user"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@a1 assumed
  relation "say"
  role subject "the neighbour"
  role object "the cough is from the tablet"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  where match
    relation "be a side effect of"
    role subject "the dry cough"
    role object "Prestarium of 5 mg"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "should stop taking"
    role subject "the user"
    role object "Prestarium"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q3 query
  where match
    relation "go to"
    role subject "the user"
    role destination "Cotnari"
    polarity affirmed
  end
